g.text: // A: ACW, B: CW, to the Entrance
// 5 Ticks apart; the median is kept
3. Storage: drive in, scan, align, refine and adjust the distance

The whole STORAGE phase in one picture: TURN, DRIVE_IN, DEPOSIT, DEPOSIT_ALIGN, the refine sweep (DEPOSIT_REFINE_*) and DEPOSIT_DISTANCE with its reverse / approach States. Dashed grey boxes are States shown in other pictures; red = fault.

DEPOSIT turns anticlockwise through a full circle (scan_deg >= 360) at 50 mm/s and keeps the closest valid echo (not 0, at most DEPOSIT_SCAN_MAX_RANGE_MM) with its gyro heading. With no echo it lights LED1 red and returns to IDLE. TURN ignores bumper and cliff; DRIVE_IN ignores
the cliff, and any bumper ends it in DEPOSIT.

DEPOSIT_ALIGN turns the short way to the saved heading. The first time, within 100 ticks, it starts the refine sweep; once the heading is refined, within 50 ticks, it goes to DEPOSIT_DISTANCE. The sweep visits 26 headings from -25 to +25 deg around the coarse heading, 2 deg

apart. DEPOSIT_REFINE_TURN turns to a step at 35 mm/s; DEPOSIT_REFINE_SAMPLE stops, waits 15 Ticks, takes 3 readings 5 Ticks apart and keeps the median. After the last step, the centre of the widest run of steps within 10 mm of the closest median becomes the heading (ties: nearest the
coarse heading). No valid median faults with LED1 red.

DEPOSIT_DISTANCE holds still for 15 Ticks (about 300 ms) so the 10 Hz sonar catches up, then reads deposit_range_mm against the target 410 mm +/- 10 mm: too close backs off in DEPOSIT_REVERSE until 510 mm (a 100 mm margin) at 50 mm/s, too far creeps in

DEPOSIT_APPROACH at 35 mm/s until 420 mm, so the last correction is always made moving forward. Inside the band it lights LED1 green, starts the win sound and returns to IDLE. All three States also fault on any bumper or cliff, or on a zero or maximum-range reading.
